name: start_wme_thread_monitor
description: Start the WME thread anomaly monitor (xctrace System Trace + 7-pattern analysis) as a background process. Returns a session_id consumed by finalize_wme_thread_monitor.

label.description: Label appended to the run directory name

target_process.description: Process name to attach xctrace to

name: finalize_wme_thread_monitor
description: Wait for the WME thread monitor session to finish, parse the anomaly report, archive the human-readable report, delete the run directory on PASS, keep it on FAIL. Returns a failure dict when anomalies at or above the configured severities are detected.

fail_on.description: Severities that should mark the step as failed

wait_timeout.description: Max seconds to wait for the recorder to finish
